body:
Founder real-time: 'wave to the player when the player gets close and then dance before resuming patrol.' gband_skel_npc_load_kit/draw gained optional per-kit greet/dance clips (GBAND_SKEL_NPC_ANIM_AUTO/GREET/DANCE), falling back to idle when a kit has no real clip for the requested gesture. Verified via the consuming SHANKPIT repo (this file has an engine dependency, no standalone GOLDENBAND test). Commits: 622aaa7, 7724cd2.

⚓ ☃
title: gband_skel_npc gains optional greet/dance gesture clips
